prog='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    modal = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def solid(vals): return len(set(vals)) == 1
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(H) if solid(grid[r]) and grid[r][0] != modal]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(W) if solid([grid[r][c] for r in range(H)]) and grid[0][c] != modal]
    def segments(n, seps):
        segs, start = [], 0
        for s in list(seps) + [n]:
            if s > start: segs.append((start, s - start))
            start = s + 1
        return segs
    rsegs = segments(H, sep_rows)
    csegs = segments(W, sep_cols)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def block(ri, cj):
        rs, rl = rsegs[ri]; cs, cl = csegs[cj]
        return [[grid[rs+i][cs+j] for j in range(cl)] for i in range(rl)]
    blocks = {(ri, cj): block(ri, cj) for ri in range(len(rsegs)) for cj in range(len(csegs))}
    def distinct(b): return len({v for row in b for v in row})
    src = max(sorted(blocks), key=lambda k: (distinct(blocks[k]), -(k[0]*len(csegs)+k[1])))
    rs, rl = rsegs[src[0]]; cs, cl = csegs[src[1]]
    for (ri, cj), b in blocks.items():
        if (ri, cj) == src or distinct(b) > 1:
            continue
        r0, rlen = rsegs[ri]; c0, clen = csegs[cj]
        for i in range(min(rlen, rl)):
            for j in range(min(clen, cl)):
                out[r0+i][c0+j] = grid[rs+i][cs+j]
    return out
'''
